title_original: All of a Sudden, Clarissa, La Gradiva, The Invite, and Tender Loving Care Lead 2026 Gotham Awards Nominations

blocks.text: The first major year-end awards ceremony has unveiled its nominations. The 2026 Gotham Film Awards nominations are led by All of a Sudden, Clarissa, La Gradiva, The Invite and Tender Loving Care , with four nods each.

Best Feature nominations include Clarissa , Club Kid, The Debut, Dreams in Nightmares, The Invite, Josephine, Mouse, Paper Tiger, Primetime, Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma , and Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother , while Best International Feature includes All of a Sudden, Ben’Imana, Blue Heron, Everytime, Fatherland, Filipiñana, La Gradiva, Minotaur, Possible Love , and Tender Loving Care .

“It’s a pleasure to announce this year’s nominees. It has been a remarkable year for film, with audiences turning out in theaters for bold, distinctive work from first-time filmmakers and established artists alike,” said Jeffrey Sharp, Executive Director of The Gotham Film & Media Institute. “This year’s nominations, alongside our Tributes and the return of the Audience Award, reflect that abundance and celebrate the creative community that has been at the heart of The Gothams for more than three decades.”
See the nominees below ahead of the November 30 ceremony.
